english.title: Import / acquire / possess / use a regulated explosives precursor without a licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a member of the general public,

(A)_[imported]_
(B)_[acquired]_
(C)_[possessed]_
(D)_[used]_

a regulated explosives precursor, namely **(..SPECIFY PRECURSOR..), without having a licence, or a recognised non-GB licence to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4(1) and (2) and 12(1) of the Control of Explosives Precursors Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
Import / acquire / possess / use a regulated explosives precursor
without a licence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: IMPORTANT NOTE - This regulation does not apply to the possession or use of a regulated explosives precursor at any time before 3rd March 2016. For the current legislation, please see the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecution:
None
